name: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Rolls with Avocado, Broccoli Slaw & Ginger Mayo

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, and soy sauce in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the dressing. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw
¾ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with mayo, additional oil, and spices. Stir to combine the ginger mayo and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup mayonnaise
toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim cucumbers and use a vegetable peeler to make thin ribbons; place on a large plate.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces and add to the plate.

To assemble the rolls, arrange cucumber ribbons on a flat surface. Divide smoked salmon and avocado between ribbons, placing them at one end. Roll tightly to secure. (Assemble in batches if necessary.)
Divide cucumber rolls and slaw between plates. Serve with ginger mayo for dipping. Enjoy!
